newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia evacuate embassy staff from Congo.
newsitem.headline: Russia evacuate embassy staff from Congo.

text.p: Russia has evacuated its embassy staff from Congo's capital Brazzaville, which has been devastated by fighting, the Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.

"All staff members of the embassy and the remaining members of their families were evacuated by a French military plane to Libreville, the capital of Gabon," ministry spokesman Gennady Tarasov told a regular press briefing.
He said the evacuation followed France's decision earlier this week to pull out its 1,200 troops despite pleas from a U.N. envoy for some to stay.

France also helped to evacuate more than 5,000 foreign nationals, including the Russians, caught by the bloody political and ethnic dispute that has left the streets of the capital strewn with bodies.
Brazzaville enjoyed a second morning of calm on Thursday as a 72-hour ceasefire due to expire at midnight on Friday held firm.

The forces of President Pascal Lissouba and foes backing his predecessor Denis Sassou Nguesso are maintaining the ceasefire. Fighting broke out on June 5 when Lissouba's rump government forces tried to disarm Sassou Nguesso's "Cobras".
